payload.name: Tamarind Bio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to your Tamarind Bio workspace for protein and molecular science. Validate, estimate, submit, and monitor jobs across 300+ tools — structure prediction, docking, protein and antibody design, molecular dynamics, and property prediction. Chain tools into pipelines, batch many inputs at once, and pull back structures, results, and logs — all from chat.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Tamarind Bio 工作区，开展蛋白质和分子科学研究。使用 300+ 种工具验证、估算、提交并监控任务，涵盖结构预测、对接、蛋白质和抗体设计、分子动力学及性质预测。将工具串联成流水线，一次批量提交多个输入，并直接在聊天中获取结构、结果和日志。

payload.name: Inductive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Inductive's absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) models predict the chemical and pharmacokinetic properties that determine whether a molecule can become a viable drug. By surfacing these predictions directly in your conversation, scientists can evaluate compounds, triage ideas, and prioritize which molecules to synthesize, without leaving their existing workflow.

Through this MCP server, users can access Inductive’s models for the physicochemical properties LogD (lipophilicity) and pKa (acid/base ionization), key drivers of solubility and permeability.
payload.longDescription:
Inductive 的吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）模型可预测决定分子能否成为可行药物的化学和药代动力学性质。科学家无需离开现有工作流，即可在对话中查看这些预测、评估化合物、筛选想法，并确定优先合成哪些分子。

通过此 MCP 服务器，用户可使用 Inductive 模型预测 LogD（亲脂性）和 pKa（酸碱电离）等物理化学性质；这些性质是溶解性和渗透性的关键影响因素。

payload.longDescription: Proto 可帮助用户运行生物 AI 和生物信息学工具、检查其架构和示例、运行分析和模型、将这些工具部署到 Modal 计算工作区，并通过 ChatGPT 收集或获取已存储的结果。

payload.name: Rowan
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use Rowan in ChatGPT to run and manage computational chemistry and structural biology workflows. Predict molecular properties, search conformers and reaction paths, and calculate energies, structures, spectra, and electronic properties with quantum chemistry. Prepare proteins and run structure prediction, docking, molecular dynamics, and binding affinity workflows. Calculations are saved to Rowan and available in the web app,  while existing Rowan work can be viewed and managed from ChatGPT. Track jobs, inspect results, and download supported files.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中使用 Rowan 运行和管理计算化学及结构生物学工作流。预测分子性质，搜索构象和反应路径，并通过量子化学计算能量、结构、光谱及电子性质。准备蛋白质，并运行结构预测、分子对接、分子动力学和结合亲和力工作流。计算结果保存到 Rowan，可在其 Web 应用中访问；已有的 Rowan 工作也可通过 ChatGPT 查看和管理。跟踪任务、检查结果，并下载受支持的文件。

payload.name: Genomic Intelligence
payload.description: 使用 AI 分析 DNA 序列
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Run six DNA sequence-analysis tasks over the hosted Genomic Intelligence API: promoter region prediction, splice donor/acceptor sites, enhancer activity, chromatin state, sequence-to-expression, and de-novo gene annotation, plus a composite find-genes-then-predict-expression workflow. Give it a gene symbol, a genomic region, or a FASTA; it resolves the sequence from Ensembl and returns structured predictions. No local GPU, model weights, or API key required. For research use, not clinical or diagnostic decisions.
payload.longDescription: 通过托管的 Genomic Intelligence API 执行六类 DNA 序列分析任务：启动子区域预测、剪接供体/受体位点、增强子活性、染色质状态、序列到表达的预测，以及从头基因注释；还可执行“查找基因后预测表达”的组合工作流。输入基因符号、基因组区域或 FASTA 序列，应用会从 Ensembl 解析序列并返回结构化预测。无需本地 GPU、模型权重或 API 密钥。仅供研究使用，不用于临床或诊断决策。

payload.name: Pendar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pendar gives you the shape of a research field, not a summary of it.

Point it at a topic and it reports how many papers exist, whether output is growing or flattening, which disciplines and countries produce them, and which papers to read first. Every figure is counted across the whole corpus rather than estimated from a sample, so you can plan around it.

Point it at a paper and it traces what happened next: whether citations are rising or fading, which fields picked the work up, whether industry or academia is building on it, and which authors cite it most. That is how you tell a paper quietly becoming foundational from one that peaked years ago.

Paste a bibliography and it checks each reference against the published record: whether the paper exists, whether the citation describes it accurately, and whether it has been retracted. A reference it cannot find is reported as unverified rather than swapped for the nearest real paper, which matters when the citations came from a model.

Every tool is read-only. Pendar looks things up and reports what it finds.
payload.longDescription:
Pendar 为您展示研究领域的全貌，而不只是摘要。

输入一个主题，它会报告相关论文数量、研究产出是在增长还是趋于平缓、哪些学科和国家在产出论文，以及应优先阅读哪些论文。每项数据都基于整个语料库统计，而非根据样本估算，帮助您据此进行规划。

输入一篇论文，它会追踪后续发展：引用是在增加还是减少、哪些领域采用了这项研究、业界或学界是否在此基础上继续研究，以及引用该论文最多的作者。这有助于判断一篇论文是在悄然成为奠基性研究，还是早在数年前就已达到热度高峰。

粘贴参考文献目录后，它会逐条对照已发表记录进行核查：论文是否存在、引文描述是否准确，以及论文是否已撤稿。找不到的参考文献会标记为“未验证”，而不会替换成最接近的真实论文；当引文来自模型时，这一点尤为重要。

所有工具均为只读。Pendar 只会查找并报告结果。

payload.name: PeptidePrices COA Verifier
payload.description: 核验肽类 COA 证据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and inspect public peptide certificates of analysis using the PeptidePrices evidence library and supported laboratory records. Look up exact report identifiers or public certificate URLs, review vendor and compound matches, inspect reported testing panels, browse a vendor’s published certificate feed, or compare documented COA coverage across vendors. Results keep laboratory-record confirmation, vendor attribution, product and labeled-strength matching, reported analytical results, and physical-vial chain of custody separate. Missing, blocked, unsupported, or unresolved records remain unknown rather than being treated as failures. Each result includes structured evidence and links to PeptidePrices, certificate documents, and specific official laboratory records when available.
payload.longDescription: 利用 PeptidePrices 证据库及受支持的实验室记录，搜索和检查公开的肽类分析证书（COA）。查找精确的报告编号或公开证书 URL，查看供应商和化合物的匹配情况，检查报告中的检测项目，浏览供应商发布的证书列表，或比较不同供应商有记录支持的 COA 覆盖情况。结果会分别呈现实验室记录确认、供应商归属、产品及标签标示含量或浓度的匹配、报告中的分析结果，以及实体样品瓶的保管交接链。缺失、访问受阻、不受支持或尚未解决的记录仍标为未知，不会被视为核验失败。每项结果都包含结构化证据，以及指向 PeptidePrices、证书文件和具体官方实验室记录（如有）的链接。

payload.name: Peptide Critic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Peptide Critic provides independent vendor reviews, third-party lab testing and price comparison for research peptides such as BPC-157, GHK-Cu and TB-500. Find compounds by name or synonym, compare vendor ratings and review counts, inspect vendor-level lab-verified COA and warning flags, compare list and discounted prices per milligram, and find coupon codes. Filter comparisons by vendors' shipping origin and pack size, or look up a vendor profile. Results use Peptide Critic's Best Value ranking, which favors partners when offers are comparable; returned buy links are tracked affiliate links. The app returns public catalogue data without sign-in and does not place orders or process payments. Prescription-drug analogues are excluded from compound search and comparison. Research use only; no dosing or medical advice.
payload.longDescription: Peptide Critic 为 BPC-157、GHK-Cu 和 TB-500 等研究肽提供独立供应商评价、第三方实验室检测和价格比较。按名称或同义词查找化合物，比较供应商评分和评价数量，查看供应商级别的实验室验证 COA 及警示标志，比较每毫克的标价和折扣价，并查找优惠码。可按供应商发货地和包装规格筛选，或查看供应商档案。结果采用 Peptide Critic 的最佳价值排名，在报价相当时倾向合作伙伴；返回的购买链接为跟踪型联盟链接。应用无需登录即可返回公开目录数据，不下单也不处理付款。处方药类似物不纳入化合物搜索和比较。仅供研究使用；不提供剂量或医疗建议。

payload.name: HoldsUp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HoldsUp checks what health and science podcasts claim against the published research. Ask whether a claim has been checked and get the verdict (supported, overstated, needs context, contradicted or unverified), the GRADE certainty, a one-line note and the studies behind it with their PubMed id, evidence level and retraction status. Verify a new claim live against PubMed and OpenAlex in 20 to 70 seconds. Read a speaker's track record, a show, a topic, a single study, or the money behind it from public funding registers. Sign in by email, pay per call from prepaid credits (1 credit = 1 US cent: a read 1, a claim search 2, a live verification 30), and see the cost and your balance in every answer. Evidence summaries about published research, not medical advice.
payload.longDescription: HoldsUp 将健康和科学播客的说法与已发表研究进行核对。询问某个说法是否已核查，可获得结论（有支持、夸大、需要背景、相矛盾或未验证）、GRADE 确定性、单行说明及相关研究的 PubMed ID、证据等级和撤稿状态。通过 PubMed 和 OpenAlex 在 20 至 70 秒内实时核验新说法。还可查看演讲者履历、节目、主题、单项研究或公共资助登记中的资金来源。使用邮箱登录，预付额度按次付费（1 个额度 = 1 美分：读取 1、搜索说法 2、实时核验 30），每个回答显示费用和余额。内容是已发表研究的证据摘要，不是医疗建议。

payload.name: PartnerProf - Quanntum Core
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PartnerProf is a unique tool that provides a deterministic answer to a fundamental question: does at least one feasible state exist within a locally defined reality governed by highly complex dependencies and constraints in a high-dimensional space?

Before committing resources to complex computation or a quantum problem, PartnerProf can determine whether a desired state, result, transition, or next step is feasible at all under the currently defined conditions.

Both the input and the resulting output can be certified, while the admitted state remains deterministic, reproducible, and fully auditable.

PartnerProf enables the evaluation of quantum and high-dimensional state-space problems that would otherwise be computationally impractical, including classes of simulations that may remain intractable even for current quantum hardware.

When facing a major and costly decision—or planning an experiment, test system, detector, prototype, or complex technical configuration—PartnerProf allows you to verify first whether the intended state is actually feasible within the defined reality before investing in its realization.
payload.longDescription:
PartnerProf 是一种独特工具，为一个基本问题提供确定性答案：在高维空间中，由高度复杂的依赖关系和约束支配的局部定义现实内，是否至少存在一个可行状态？

在为复杂计算或量子问题投入资源前，PartnerProf 可以确定：在当前定义的条件下，所需状态、结果、转换或下一步是否根本可行。

输入和由此产生的输出均可获得认证，而被判定为可行的状态保持确定性、可复现性和完全可审计性。

PartnerProf 支持评估量子及高维状态空间问题，否则这些问题在计算上可能难以实际处理，其中包括某些即使在当前量子硬件上也可能仍难以求解的模拟类型。

面临重大且成本高昂的决策，或规划实验、测试系统、探测器、原型或复杂技术配置时，PartnerProf 让你在投入资源实现目标前，先验证预期状态在所定义的现实内是否确实可行。

payload.name: QualiTaTi
payload.description: 开展 AI 访谈与问卷调查
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
QualiTaTi is an AI-powered qualitative research platform used by academic and UX researchers. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your QualiTaTi account through a hosted MCP server, so you can run a study end to end without leaving the conversation.

What you can do:
- Interview studies: create an AI-interview project from a topic, draft or refine the interview guide, set the language, voice or text mode and duration, and get the participant link to share. QualiTaTi's AI interviewer then runs the interviews with your participants and transcribes them. You can also import transcripts you already have.
- Progress and results: list your projects and interviews, see which interviews are complete and analysed, read each interview's conversation and quality score, and read the stored analyses (themes, codes, digests).
- Analysis: run the complete analysis or inductive coding on a finished interview (this spends QualiTaTi credits and is always confirmed with you first), then pull the results into the chat as evidence-backed summaries with verbatim quotes.
- Conversational surveys: build a survey from a brief, add questions and publish it; responses are then reviewed on qualitati.com.

Three bundled skills teach the model QualiTaTi's workflows: setting up an interview study, building a survey, and reading results. The plugin works with a free QualiTaTi account. Sign-in uses OAuth 2.1; the grant inherits your plan and quotas, and access tokens expire automatically.
payload.longDescription:
QualiTaTi 是供学术和 UX 研究人员使用的 AI 定性研究平台。此插件通过托管的 MCP 服务器将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到你的 QualiTaTi 账户，让你无需离开对话即可完成端到端研究。

你可以：
- 访谈研究：围绕某个主题创建 AI 访谈项目、起草或完善访谈指南、设置语言、语音或文字模式及访谈时长，并获取可分享给参与者的链接。之后，QualiTaTi 的 AI 访谈员会与参与者进行访谈并转录内容。你也可以导入已有的文字记录。
- 进度与结果：列出项目和访谈，查看哪些访谈已完成并分析，阅读每次访谈的对话和质量评分，以及已保存的分析结果（主题、编码、摘要）。
- 分析：对已完成的访谈运行完整分析或归纳编码（这会消耗 QualiTaTi 额度，并且每次都会先征得你的确认），然后将结果提取到聊天中，生成有证据支持且包含原文引述的摘要。
- 对话式问卷：根据简报构建问卷、添加问题并发布；随后可在 qualitati.com 上查看回复。

随附的三项技能可教会模型 QualiTaTi 的工作流：开展访谈研究、构建问卷和阅读结果。此插件可配合免费的 QualiTaTi 账户使用。登录采用 OAuth 2.1；授权会继承你的方案和配额，访问令牌会自动过期。

payload.name: SciGrant
payload.description: 公募要領と様式から研究費申請書を項目ごとに作成
payload.summaryOriginal: 公募要領と様式から研究費申請書を項目ごとに作成
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
公募要領と申請書テンプレートに沿って、研究費申請の構想を整理し、申請書ドラフトを項目ごとに作成する会員向けの支援です。制度条件、審査観点、字数・様式制限を確認し、申請項目の整理、研究構想の具体化、項目ごとの執筆、予算・体制の整理、全体レビュー、提出前確認へ段階的に進みます。公募資料にない締切・予算上限・応募資格や、未実施の研究成果を推測で埋めません。

プラグインを選択して公募要領と申請書テンプレートを添付するだけでも開始できます。片方しかない場合は不足する資料だけを確認し、項目や工程ごとに利用者の確認を待ちながら進めます。生成された文章、引用文献、数値と公募条件は利用者による確認が必要です。採択を保証するサービスではありません。

完全版の執筆支援には、SciGrantの有効な利用権を登録した会員アカウントへの接続が必要です。既存の購入者は、提供済みの有料note内の登録リンクで製品の利用権を登録し、ChatGPT／Codexでプラグインを追加した後、登録時と同じログイン方法・同じ会員アカウントで接続してください。会員アカウントはnoteやChatGPTの登録アカウントと異なっていても利用できます。ログインだけでは利用権は付与されず、SciDraftの利用権とは別です。

会員サーバーは認証、製品別の利用権確認、保存済み執筆手順の配信を行い、その手順を受けたChatGPT／Codexが作成を支援します。研究資料・原稿・会話本文をMCPツールの入力として受け取りません。資料はChatGPT／Codexの会話に添付してください。申請システムへのログイン、実提出、決済は行いません。

利用期限は年度版ごとに定められ、購入日から1年間とは限りません。期限終了・利用停止後は完全版手順を新しく取得できません。既に取得した内容や過去のチャットを削除するものではありません。

payload.name: Tabulous
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your AI assistant to a Tabulous workspace. It can look up Registry tables and records, list files on a record, and inspect toolkit scripts and apps, so you can ask questions about samples, experiments, and other lab data without leaving the chat.

When something needs to change, the assistant stages a complete plan as a changeset and gives you a review link. Invalid plans are rejected up front. Nothing is written to live data until you approve it.
payload.longDescription:
将 AI 助手连接到 Tabulous 工作区。它可以查询 Registry 表和记录、列出记录中的文件，并检查工具包脚本和应用，让你无需离开聊天就能询问样本、实验和其他实验室数据。

需要更改内容时，助手会将完整计划整理成变更集，并提供审核链接。无效计划会预先拒绝。在你批准之前，不会将任何内容写入线上数据。

payload.name: Selenium
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your B12 account to research chemical synthesis strategies, assess routes, and develop a selected strategy into a detailed route. Compare literature evidence, starting materials, reaction steps, and uncertainties. Revisit saved assessments and planning results across conversations. Research and route-development availability depends on your account configuration. Proposed routes require expert review and experimental validation.
payload.longDescription: 连接您的B12账户以研究化学合成策略，评估路线，并将选定策略转化为详细路线。比较文献证据、起始材料、反应步骤和不确定性。在对话中回顾已保存的评估和规划结果。研究及路线开发功能的可用性取决于您的账户配置。建议的路线需要经过专家评审和实验验证。

payload.name: Biohub ESM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Biohub ESM helps you understand proteins from a name, sequence, or file: explore mutation landscapes, interpret what ESMC sees, predict and view all-atom structures, and discover related proteins. It chooses the right ESM workflow, preserves confidence and provenance, and presents results automatically. It also supports MSA-guided and modified-complex workflows, and private or large-scale compute routing. Supported protein sequences use the Biohub MCP viewer. Complexes and exact prediction files use a separate molecular viewer when available, with an agent-generated static rendering as a last resort where local rendering tools are available. Managed inference requires a Biohub API key and may incur usage charges. Predictions support research hypotheses, not experimental conclusions.
payload.longDescription: Biohub ESM可通过蛋白质名称、序列或文件帮助您深入理解：探索突变图谱，解析ESMC看到的内容，预测并查看全原子结构，发现相关蛋白质。它会自动选择合适的ESM工作流，保留置信度和来源信息，并呈现结果。该工具支持多序列比对引导和修改后的复杂工作流，以及私有化或大规模计算资源调度。受支持的蛋白质序列使用Biohub MCP查看器，复合物和精确预测文件在可用时会使用独立分子查看器，当地渲染工具可用时则以代理生成的静态渲染作为最后手段。管理推理需要Biohub API密钥，可能产生使用费用。预测结果支持研究假设，而非实验结论。

payload.name: Prognyx oncology intelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Live ClinicalTrials.gov oncology trial comparison around an asset, plus landscapes and CI briefings.

Free, read-only MCP server from Prognyx (oncology competitive intelligence). Three tools: compare_trials returns up to three interventional ClinicalTrials.gov studies around an asset or target in one oncology indication, side by side (sponsor, phase, status, declared arms, primary outcomes, last update, registry URL); search_registry gives the live landscape of a target, company, indication or NCT number (study counts, leading sponsors, phase mix, recent studies, related briefings); search_briefings searches Prognyx briefings, where each claim links to a primary source. No account, no API key. Registry records describe declared designs; a match does not establish that two programmes compete.
payload.longDescription:
围绕特定资产的实时临床试验.gov肿瘤学试验对比，以及全景图和CI简报。

payload.longDescription: IsThisSpam 会根据结构化的诈骗信号和谨慎的安全指引，检查可疑电话号码、消息、链接、网站和电子邮件地址。结果会区分可能的诈骗与尚未核实的发现；任何结果都不能保证绝对安全。

payload.name: CookieYes
payload.description: 网页隐私与 Cookie 同意
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage cookie consent and compliance without leaving ChatGPT. Privacy laws like GDPR and CCPA require websites to get visitor consent before using cookies. CookieYes is the consent management platform (CMP) that handles this for 1.5M+ websites. This connector puts it inside your chat. Check whether your cookie banner is live. Run a cookie scan to find every cookie and tracker on your site. Review your GDPR and CCPA compliance settings. Update your cookie banner in seconds. Typical requests: "Audit my site for GDPR compliance", "Is my cookie banner active?", "Run a cookie scan and show me what you find", "Check my CCPA opt-out setup". CookieYes supports GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, US state privacy laws, and Google Consent Mode v2. That means opt-in cookie consent for European laws, and opt-out with "Do Not Sell or Share" for US ones. Built for privacy and legal teams confirming compliance, marketers checking client sites, and developers managing cookie banners. The connector covers consent management, cookie scans, and compliance checks in plain conversation.
payload.longDescription: 无需离开 ChatGPT 管理 Cookie 同意和合规。GDPR 和 CCPA 等隐私法律要求网站在使用 Cookie 前取得访客同意。CookieYes 是服务超过 1.5M+ 个网站的同意管理平台（CMP）。此连接器将它带入聊天。检查 Cookie 横幅是否上线；扫描网站以找出每个 Cookie 和跟踪器；查看 GDPR 和 CCPA 合规设置；几秒内更新 Cookie 横幅。常见请求包括：“审核我的网站 GDPR 合规性”“我的 Cookie 横幅启用了吗？”“运行 Cookie 扫描并展示结果”“检查我的 CCPA 退出设置”。CookieYes 支持 GDPR、CCPA/CPRA、美国州级隐私法和 Google Consent Mode v2，即欧洲法律的 Cookie 选择加入，以及美国法律的“请勿出售或共享”选择退出。面向确认合规性的隐私和法律团队、检查客户网站的营销人员，以及管理 Cookie 横幅的开发者。连接器以自然对话覆盖同意管理、Cookie 扫描和合规检查。

payload.name: Above Security
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Above brings your identity-security data into ChatGPT. Ask in plain language to list open incidents and high-risk identities; inspect incident timelines, evidence, and insights; look up devices, monitored applications, and audit logs; and run investigative searches across your tenant. You can also triage from chat — set incident status, verdict, and resolution notes, or add an identity to the watch list. Access requires an Above Security account and is scoped to your role and company; read and write are governed by explicit OAuth consent.
payload.longDescription: Above 将你的身份安全数据带入 ChatGPT。使用日常语言列出未结事件和高风险身份，检查事件时间线、证据及洞察，查询设备、受监控应用和审计日志，并在整个租户范围内执行调查搜索。还可以在聊天中分诊处理：设置事件状态、判定结果和解决备注，或将某个身份加入观察名单。访问需要 Above Security 账户，范围受你的角色和公司限制；读取和写入均受明确的 OAuth 授权约束。

payload.name: Breeze
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Breeze helps authenticated users explore their organization's security posture, connected integrations, scan status, tenants, and entity risk data through ChatGPT and Codex.
payload.longDescription: Breeze 帮助通过身份验证的用户在 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中查看组织的安全状况、已连接的集成、扫描状态、租户及实体风险数据。

payload.name: Safeguard
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Safeguard helps users inspect software supply chain risk from ChatGPT, including vulnerabilities, SBOMs, findings, projects, components, policies, guardrails, compliance reports, remediation plans, SCM integrations, notifications, and organization workflows.
payload.longDescription: Safeguard 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 检查软件供应链风险，涵盖漏洞、软件物料清单（SBOM）、发现项、项目、组件、策略、防护规则、合规报告、修复计划、源代码管理（SCM）集成、通知和组织工作流。

payload.name: Orca Security
payload.description: 修复代码、云和 AI 风险
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Extend Orca Security's reasoning into ChatGPT. That means every asset, alert, identity, and dependency is already stitched together in Orca’s Unified Data Model before users ask a question. Every answer factors in reachability, blast radius, and business impact from the first response.

For teams that want the reasoning without writing the prompts, Orca maintains the AI Skills Hub, an open-source GitHub repo of agent skills. Type "triage alert orca-9012345" and the orca-alert-triage skill handles retrieval, analysis, and formatting. Teams can fork it, modify it, and extend it to their own use cases.

The result: security and engineering teams work across cloud, code, and AI from a single workspace, with Orca's reasoning behind every answer.
payload.longDescription:
将 Orca Security 的推理能力扩展到 ChatGPT。这意味着在用户提问之前，每项资产、告警、身份和依赖项都已在 Orca 统一数据模型中关联。每个答案从首次响应起就会考虑可达性、爆炸半径和业务影响。
对于希望直接获得推理而无需编写提示的团队，Orca

维护 AI Skills Hub，这是一个开源 GitHub 代理技能仓库。输入“triage alert orca-9012345”，orca-alert-triage 技能就会负责检索、分析和格式化。团队可以派生、修改并扩展到自己的使用场景。

结果是安全和工程团队可在一个工作区中处理云、代码和 AI，每个答案背后都有 Orca 的推理。

payload.name: Codex Security Cloud
payload.description: 在各代码库中查找并修复漏洞
payload.summaryOriginal: Find and fix vulnerabilities across your repositories
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Run security scans, investigate findings, and manage workflows for the current workspace.
payload.longDescription: 为当前工作区运行安全扫描、调查发现结果并管理工作流。

payload.name: RelayShield Scam Checks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RelayShield Free Scam Checks screens links, crypto wallets, suspicious emails, and email addresses against RelayShield's threat-intelligence corpus — 115 monitored Telegram marketplaces, 494K+ indicators, 7.8M+ citations — before you click, pay, or reply. Four read-only tools: check a URL for phishing and malware, screen a crypto wallet for sanctions and scam flags, score a suspicious email for phishing signals, and look up whether an email appears in known data breaches. Free, no signup, no API key. Verdicts are FLAGGED or unknown — the tools never report anything as safe, because absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
payload.longDescription: RelayShield Free Scam Checks 会将链接、加密钱包、可疑邮件和邮箱地址与 RelayShield 威胁情报库比对，该库包含 115 个受监控 Telegram 市场、494K+ 指标和 7.8M+ 引用。四个工具全部只读：检查 URL 的钓鱼和恶意软件、筛查钱包的制裁与诈骗标记、评估可疑邮件的钓鱼信号、查询邮箱是否出现在已知数据泄露中。免费、无需注册或 API 密钥。结果只会是 FLAGGED（已标记）或 unknown（未知），不会报告“安全”，因为没有证据不等于不存在风险。

payload.name: Palisade
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Palisade helps email teams investigate SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and MTA-STS issues. Review monitored domains, DMARC pass rates and sending sources, inspect DNS and SPF records, and retrieve remediation tasks with supporting evidence. Use the results to prioritize fixes and prepare DNS change plans. This plugin provides read-only access to your Palisade account: it does not publish DNS records, modify domains, send email, or manage billing. A Palisade account is required.
payload.longDescription: Palisade 帮助邮件团队调查 SPF、DKIM、DMARC 和 MTA-STS 问题。查看受监控域名、DMARC 通过率和发送来源，检查 DNS 与 SPF 记录，并获取带证据的修复任务。利用结果确定修复优先级并准备 DNS 变更计划。此插件只读访问 Palisade 账户：不会发布 DNS 记录、修改域名、发送邮件或管理计费。需要 Palisade 账户。

payload.name: Guardio
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Guardio helps you check suspicious links and understand your online protection from ChatGPT and Codex. Check a website before opening it, or check links extracted from a suspicious message without sending the message body to Guardio.

Connect your Guardio account to review protection setup, scan activity, recent data leaks, linked-service counts, and security recommendations. You can also check whether an email address or phone number appears in known data breaches. Results describe known exposure; they do not reveal leaked passwords.

When you ask, Guardio can guide setup of its protection in a supported browser and receive your feedback about these tools. Setup depends on browser support and available permissions. Account features depend on your access and plan.

Guardio records each link check on your account, and a dangerous result appears in your account activity. A link result reports known threats at the time of the check. It is not a guarantee that a site or an entire message is safe. The plugin does not scan local executable files or provide continuous browser protection merely by being connected.
payload.longDescription:
Guardio可帮助您检查可疑链接，并了解ChatGPT和Codex中的在线保护情况。在打开网站前检查链接，或检查从可疑消息中提取的链接，而无需将消息正文发送至Guardio。

将您的Guardio账户连接以查看保护设置、扫描活动、近期数据泄露、关联服务数量和安全建议。您还可以检查电子邮箱地址或电话号码是否出现在已知数据泄露中。结果描述已知的暴露情况；它们不会揭示泄露的密码。

当您提出请求时，Guardio可以指导在支持的浏览器中设置其保护功能，并接收您对这些工具的反馈。设置取决于浏览器支持和可用权限。账户功能取决于您的访问权限和计划类型。

Guardio会在您的账户中记录每次链接检查，危险结果会在账户活动中标注。链接结果会报告检查时的已知威胁。这不代表该网站或整条消息都是安全的。该插件不会扫描本地可执行文件，仅通过连接无法提供持续的浏览器保护。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Check suspicious links, Check links in messages, Look up known email and phone breaches, Review account protection and scan activity, Review security recommendations, Set up browser protection, Send requested product feedback

payload.name: LeakData.io
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LeakData checks whether the verified email address on your connected LeakData account appears in known data breaches. Review reported breach sources, dates and affected data types to understand your email exposure.

You can also look up aggregate statistics for a five-character SHA-1 password hash prefix computed on your device. These statistics describe a group of hashes; they cannot tell whether your specific password was leaked. Never share a password or full hash.

An existing LeakData account with API access is required. This plugin supports your account's verified primary email only; domain searches and searches for other people are not supported.
payload.longDescription:
LeakData会检查您关联的LeakData账户中的已验证电子邮件地址是否出现在已知的数据泄露事件中。查看报告的泄露来源、日期和受影响的数据类型，以了解您的电子邮件泄露情况。

您还可以查询在您的设备上计算的五位字符SHA-1密码哈希前缀的汇总统计数据。这些统计信息描述了一组哈希值；它们无法说明您的具体密码是否已被泄露。切勿分享密码或完整哈希值。

需要具备API访问权限的现有LeakData账户。此插件仅支持您账户的已验证主要电子邮件；不支持域名搜索和其他人员的搜索。

payload.name: Streamingo Face Blur
payload.description: 在视频和图像中模糊人脸
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Automates face blurring in video and image files to streamline privacy compliance and data anonymization. Streamingo detects and obfuscates faces across media without destroying context, helping developers and data teams safely share, process, or publish visual media while adhering to GDPR, CCPA, and strict privacy standards.
payload.longDescription: 通过自动对视频和图像文件进行人脸模糊处理，简化隐私合规和数据匿名化流程。Streamingo能够在不破坏上下文的情况下检测并模糊媒体中的面部信息，帮助开发人员和数据团队在遵守GDPR、CCPA及严格隐私标准的前提下，安全地共享、处理或发布视觉媒体。

payload.name: Scamchecker.nl
payload.description: 检查消息中的诈骗行为
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Check a suspicious email, text message, WhatsApp message, link or screenshot for scam signals. You get your own message back with every red flag quoted and explained, a verdict (almost certainly fake, something is off, no red flags found, or unable to judge) and the next steps. It never says a message is safe and never opens the suspicious link. Built for the Netherlands and Belgium; explanations are in Dutch. No account needed, and messages are not stored.
payload.longDescription:
检查可疑的电子邮件、短信、WhatsApp消息、链接或截图中的诈骗信号。
您将收到包含所有红色警报的原始消息反馈，每个警报都会被标注并解释，附带结论（几乎可以肯定为虚假信息、存在异常、未发现红色警报或无法判断）以及下一步操作。
系统不会声明任何消息是安全的，也不会打开可疑链接。
专为荷兰和比利时设计；解释内容为荷兰语。
无需账户，且消息不会被存储。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Check messages for scam signals, Check links for lookalike domains, Check screenshots of messages

payload.name: Fraud Blocker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Verify suspicious customer, lead, and signup email addresses directly in ChatGPT with Fraud Blocker.

Fraud Blocker Email Verification helps you investigate individual email addresses before deciding how to handle an order, signup, or lead.

- **Instant Email Verification:** Check an email address on demand and receive its verification status and detailed sub-status.
- **Domain & Mail Server Checks:** See the email domain and whether valid MX records were found.
- **Address Insights:** Identify free-email providers and review suggested address corrections when available.
- **Clear Verification Results:** Ask ChatGPT to explain Fraud Blocker's verification response in plain language.
- **Account Usage:** View the connected Fraud Blocker account's remaining monthly verification capacity.

Use Fraud Blocker when reviewing a suspicious ecommerce order, lead, registration, or customer email and you want additional information before taking action.

The plugin verifies individual email addresses. It does not automatically block orders, modify checkout flows, or take actions against users on your behalf.
payload.longDescription:
通过Fraud Blocker在ChatGPT中直接验证可疑客户、潜在客户和注册电子邮件地址。

Fraud Blocker电子邮件验证帮助您在处理订单、注册或潜在客户时，先核查单个电子邮件地址。

- **即时电子邮件验证：** 按需检查电子邮件地址并获取验证状态及详细子状态。
- **域名与邮件服务器检测：** 查看电子邮件域名及是否找到有效的MX记录。
- **地址洞察：** 识别免费电子邮件服务商，并在有可用信息时查看建议的地址修正。
- **清晰验证结果：** 让ChatGPT用通俗语言解释Fraud Blocker的验证响应。
- **账户使用情况：** 查看已连接的Fraud Blocker账户剩余月度验证额度。

在审核可疑的电子商务订单、潜在客户、注册信息或客户电子邮件时，若需要采取行动前获取更多信息，可使用Fraud Blocker。

该插件用于验证单个电子邮件地址。
它不会自动阻止订单、修改结账流程或代表您对用户采取行动。

payload.name: AttackerView
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask whether a website is set up securely and get an answer in seconds. AttackerView checks a domain's security headers and Content Security Policy, clickjacking protection, the HTTP to HTTPS redirect, TLS configuration, DNS, DNSSEC and CAA records, and email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS). Each problem comes with its severity, the evidence observed and how to fix it.

For developers, founders and IT teams who want a quick read on a site's configuration, their own or one they depend on.

The check is passive: one request to the homepage plus public DNS and TLS lookups. It does not log in, crawl or send attacks, so it cannot find vulnerabilities in the application itself. No account is needed.
payload.longDescription:
只需几秒钟即可知晓网站是否安全配置。AttackerView会检测域名的安全头和内容安全策略、点击劫持防护、HTTP到HTTPS重定向、TLS配置、DNS、DNSSEC和CAA记录，以及电子邮件认证（SPF、DKIM、DMARC、MTA-STS）。每个问题都会标明严重程度、观察到的证据以及修复方法。

适用于需要快速了解网站配置（包括自身或依赖的网站）的开发者、创始人和IT团队。

检测方式为被动模式：仅需向首页发送一个请求，并进行公开的DNS和TLS查询。它不会登录、爬取或发起攻击，因此无法发现应用程序本身的漏洞。无需账户即可使用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Check security headers and Content Security Policy, Check the HTTPS redirect and TLS configuration, Check DNS, DNSSEC and CAA records, Check SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MTA-STS

payload.name: Screenata
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Screenata manages security compliance and audit preparation for startups. Track audit-cycle readiness for SOC 2 Type I and Type II, HIPAA, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, investigate failing security checks and collect evidence linked to the relevant tests. Review a proposed fix before applying it, then re-run the check to verify the result. Draft security policies from your recorded answers and open direct browser links to review controls, tests, policies, risks and evidence. After signing in to Screenata and selecting a workspace, assess selected cloud accounts, identity services, code repositories and a local repository. New users create their account in the browser. Cloud checks run on Screenata servers with account-specific consent; provider credentials stay out of chat and tool arguments, and repository source stays local. Fix availability depends on the check and permissions, policies need human approval, and baseline scores are separate from audit readiness. Your auditor issues the report or certification.
payload.longDescription: Screenata为初创企业提供的安全合规及审计准备管理服务。跟踪SOC 2类型I和类型II、HIPAA、ISO 27001和ISO 42001的审计周期准备情况，调查失败的安全检查并收集与相关测试相关的证据。在应用修复方案前进行审查，然后重新运行检查以验证结果。根据您的录音回答起草安全策略，并通过浏览器直接链接查看控制措施、测试内容、政策、风险和证据。登录Screenata并选择工作区后，可评估选定的云账户、身份服务、代码仓库和本地仓库。新用户通过浏览器创建账户。云检查在Screenata服务器上运行并需账户特定授权；提供商凭据不会进入聊天记录或工具参数，代码库源代码保留在本地。修复方案的可用性取决于检查内容和权限，政策需要人工审批，基准分数与审计准备状态相互独立。您的审计机构将出具报告或认证。

payload.name: Is This AI Agent Safe?
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask whether an AI agent, MCP server, coding assistant or AI product is safe to use, and get a straight verdict from Greenlit Books, with the setup steps that make it safer and a link to the full review. Each verdict comes from reading the product's own code, docs and settings, and says which version it read and when. There are more than 800 of them, covering coding assistants, automation tools and hundreds of MCP servers.

It also checks statements about AI agents against a ledger of 564 claims, each sorted by what it rests on (a published result, the book's argument, a method you can run, or the author's own account) and each with a citation. Where a claim rests on an outside source, the result says what that source does and does not establish.

Ask it how or why about working with AI agents and it answers from Greenlit's books: it finds the passage in the free first chapters, the concept pages, the glossary and the claim ledger that bears on your question, quotes it with a link to the exact section, and points you to the page where the rest of the topic is. And when you want to go deeper, it finds the right practical book on working with AI, with a free first chapter to read.

Read-only. No account and no sign-in. Nothing you ask is stored beyond short-lived request logs.
payload.longDescription:
询问AI代理、MCP服务器、编码助手或AI产品是否安全可用，Greenlit Books将提供直接评估结果，包含提升安全性的设置步骤以及完整评测链接。每个评估均基于产品自身代码、文档和设置进行阅读分析，并注明所读版本及时间。目前已有超过800份评估，涵盖编码助手、自动化工具和数百个MCP服务器。

它还会将AI代理相关声明与564项声明清单进行核对，每项声明按依据类型分类（已发表结果、本书论点、可运行方法或作者个人陈述），并附带引用来源。当声明基于外部资料时，结果会说明该来源实际建立和未建立的内容。

询问AI代理的工作原理或原因时，它会引用Greenlit书籍内容：在免费第一章、概念页面、术语表和声明清单中查找相关部分，引用内容并附精确章节链接，同时指引至完整话题页面。当需要深入学习时，会推荐合适的实践书籍，并提供可阅读的免费第一章。

只读模式。无需账户和登录。除短期请求日志外，不会存储任何提问内容。

Diopter AI checks whether a photo, video, or audio clip was generated or manipulated by AI. Upload a file in chat or share a link, and Diopter runs it through its trained deepfake detection models, then returns a verdict (for example: no AI detected, AI-generated, or inconclusive) with a confidence level and a link to the full report on diopter.ai.

Use it to sanity-check a suspicious image before sharing it, verify a video someone sent you, or look up the result of an earlier scan by its request ID. Sign in with your Diopter account to keep a history of your scans in your dashboard.

Each check is saved to your Diopter account, so ChatGPT asks you to confirm before running it.

Diopter analyzes media. It does not create, edit, or alter images, video, or audio, and it does not identify the people in them.

Detection is probabilistic: treat results as evidence to weigh, not a guarantee.
payload.longDescription:
Diopter AI可检测照片、视频或音频片段是否由AI生成或被篡改。您可通过聊天上传文件或分享链接，Diopter将通过其训练好的深度伪造检测模型进行分析，随后返回检测结论（例如：未检测到AI、AI生成或结果不确定）及置信度，并提供指向diopter.ai完整报告的链接。

payload.name: BlindOracle Agent Trust
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BlindOracle Agent Trust answers one question before you work with or hire an AI agent: what is its record?

What it does
- Trust badge: a one-line badge for an agent name or wallet, built from BlindOracle's audit registry and settlement history. An agent BlindOracle has never seen comes back as UNVERIFIED with empty fields; the plugin never invents a score.
- Reputation lookup: completed and failed jobs, disputes and the trust-score trend for the same subject.
- Service list: which BlindOracle services exist and which ones can be used from ChatGPT.

How it works
All tools are read-only. Lookups share a daily limit across all ChatGPT users; when it is reached the tool says so and you can try again the next day. Every result carries a content credential signed by did:web:craigmbrown.com, and the result card shows that the signature is attached. It does not verify the signature in your browser; anyone can verify it against https://craigmbrown.com/.well-known/did.json.

What it does not do
The plugin never asks for wallet keys, seed phrases or payment details and never moves funds. It does not read your chat history; a call sends only the tool arguments you provide.

Who it is for
People and teams choosing agents to delegate work to, marketplace operators vetting counterparties, and developers building agent-to-agent workflows who want an independent record before the first transaction.

Limits
BlindOracle's record covers agents that have transacted with or been audited through BlindOracle. A missing record means "no record here", not "unsafe". Badges expire and are reissued; the expiry date is shown with each badge.
payload.longDescription:
BlindOracle Agent Trust在您合作或雇佣AI代理前，回答一个关键问题：它的记录如何？

功能说明
- 信任徽章：通过BlindOracle的审计注册表和结算记录生成的单行徽章，用于代理名称或钱包地址。
对于BlindOracle从未见过的代理，会显示为“未验证”且字段为空；插件不会自行编造评分。
- 信誉查询：显示同一主体的已完成和失败任务、争议记录以及信任评分趋势。
- 服务列表：展示BlindOracle现有的服务，以及可在ChatGPT中使用的服务项。

工作原理
所有工具均为只读模式。
所有查询共享ChatGPT用户的每日限额；达到上限后工具会提示，并可在次日重试。
每个结果均带有由did:web:craigmbrown.com签名的内容凭证，结果卡片会显示签名已附加。
该工具不会在浏览器中验证签名；任何人都可访问https://craigmbrown.com/.well-known/did.json进行验证。

不支持的功能
插件不会请求钱包密钥、种子短语或支付信息，也不会操作资金。
不会读取您的聊天记录；调用仅发送您提供的工具参数。

适用对象
适用于需要委派工作的个人和团队、需审核交易对手的市场运营方，以及希望在首次交易前获取独立记录的开发者。

数据范围
BlindOracle的记录覆盖与BlindOracle有过交易或接受过审计的代理。
记录缺失仅表示“此处无记录”，不代表“不安全”。
徽章会过期并重新签发；每次徽章均显示有效期限。

payload.name: ScamCheck
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ScamCheck analyzes a message (email, SMS, private message), a single link or domain, or a sender (email address or number) and returns the fraud and phishing risk signals it detects — for example urgency and pressure, a request to pay or to click, a shortened link, a raw IP address, a missing HTTPS, a look-alike or free-address domain. It uses a deterministic heuristic model: the same input always gives the same signals, nothing is generated by a language model, no account is needed, nothing is stored and no file is read. The result is an ANALYSIS of risk signals, not a guaranteed verdict: a high number of signals suggests caution, but the absence of a signal does not prove a message is safe. ScamCheck also returns practical safety tips and official reporting resources (the Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre). It is an information and prevention tool; it does not contact anyone, does not report on your behalf and does not open attachments.
payload.longDescription:
ScamCheck可分析消息（电子邮件、短信、私信）、单个链接或域名，或发件人（电子邮件地址或电话号码），并返回其检测到的欺诈和钓鱼风险信号——例如紧迫感和压力、要求付款或点击的请求、缩短的链接、原始IP地址、缺少HTTPS、相似域名或免费邮箱域名。
它采用确定性启发式模型：相同输入始终会返回相同信号，不会通过语言模型生成内容，无需账户，不存储任何数据，也不读取文件。
结果是对风险信号的分析，而非绝对判定：信号数量多需提高警惕，但未检测到信号并不证明信息安全。
ScamCheck还会提供实用的安全建议和官方举报资源（加拿大反欺诈中心）。
这是一款信息与预防工具；它不会联系任何人、不会代为举报，也不会打开附件。

payload.name: ScanMalware
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ScanMalware helps security teams investigate suspicious and phishing URLs. It renders a URL in a sandboxed browser, records what the page loaded and did, and keeps public scans in a searchable archive, so one reported phishing page can lead to the rest of its campaign.

With this plugin you can:
- Look up what the archive already knows about a domain, URL or IP address: the scanner's verdict and risk factors, network requests, indicators, TLS and JARM details, detected technologies, YARA matches, OCR text and RDAP data.
- Find related scans by domain, IP, ASN, JARM signature, favicon hash, screenshot hash, fuzzy hash, OCR text, tracking key or JavaScript fingerprint.
- Look up Certificate Transparency records for a domain or IP.
- Submit a new URL for scanning, choosing whether the result is public or unlisted, and read the verdict when the scan completes.

The included skill walks through pivoting from one phishing URL to its sibling hosts, and avoids two common mistakes: giving a domain a verdict that belongs to a page that only redirected to it, or to another tenant on a shared hosting platform; and blocking on shared IP addresses or TLS fingerprints that describe a hosting platform rather than an attacker.

ScanMalware is a defensive tool. Pages are opened in ScanMalware's isolated browser, not on your device. No account or API key is needed. 126 of the 128 tools only read data; the two that write submit a URL for scanning and record a safe or malicious vote on a scan. A public scan publishes the URL and its results, so use "unlisted" for confidential targets.

ScanMalware is operated by Triop AB in Sweden.
payload.longDescription:
ScanMalware帮助安全团队调查可疑及钓鱼网址。它会在沙盒浏览器中渲染网址，记录页面加载内容及操作行为，并将公开扫描结果存入可搜索的档案库，因此一个被举报的钓鱼页面可关联到整个攻击链。

通过此插件您可以：
- 查询档案库中已知的域名/网址/IP地址信息：扫描器的判定结果与风险因素、网络请求记录、指标数据、TLS和JARM详情、检测到的技术、YARA匹配项、OCR文字内容及RDAP数据。
- 通过域名、IP、ASN、JARM签名、favicon哈希、截图哈希、模糊哈希、OCR文字、追踪密钥或JavaScript指纹查找关联扫描记录。
- 查询域名或IP的证书透明度记录。
- 提交新网址进行扫描，选择结果是否公开或隐藏，并在扫描完成后查看判定结果。

内置的关联技能可引导您从一个钓鱼网址追踪到其子域名主机，同时避免两个常见错误：将仅通过重定向指向该域名的页面判定为该域名的威胁等级；或因共享主机平台的其他租户而误封共享IP地址或TLS指纹。

ScanMalware是一款防御工具。
网址会在ScanMalware的隔离浏览器中打开，而非您的设备。
无需账户或API密钥。128个工具中有126个仅用于读取数据；其余两个功能用于提交网址扫描并为扫描结果投票判定安全或恶意。
公开扫描会发布网址及其结果，因此对机密目标请使用「隐藏」选项。
